business_problem: KRAFTON needed to unify game and customer data across many studios because inconsistent access patterns and fragmented pipelines were slowing decision-making, collaboration, and privacy-aware innovation.
solution_summary: KRAFTON uses Databricks Data + AI Platform and Unity Catalog to support governed game analytics and privacy-aware AI operations. KRAFTON needed to unify game and customer data across many studios because inconsistent access patterns and fragmented pipelines were slowing decision-making, collaboration, and privacy-aware innovation. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Legacy operational and analytics data are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports Watch video 20PB, 60TB, and Of streaming data processed each day 2,000, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: KRAFTON reported Watch video 20PB, 60TB, and Of streaming data processed each day 2,000, improving governed game analytics and privacy-aware AI operations with measurable gains in productivity improvement, risk reduction, and scalability.
